rules: Private by default; membership is not sharing consent.
Stable keys are scoped to the author; names do not merge people or projects.
In a shared space, a person mentioned in a snapshot is shown as the space member it unambiguously names (the author, or the only member with that full or first name). Private graphs are never merged.
Entity properties describe identity. Changing states, deadlines and preferences are claims.
A shared claim is a snapshot; source revisions do not silently republish it.
Evidence is an attributed excerpt, not independent verification.
Forgetting a source removes its claims and publications. Retraction stops future reads.
An explicit negation is a claim with negated=true; it is never stored as the affirmative fact.
When no relationship fits, extraction may propose a provisional one. It is usable immediately, reused by later extractions, and approved, merged or rejected by an ontology reviewer.

types.name: Person
types.description: A mentioned person. A name alone never links a platform account.

types.name: Project
types.description: An ongoing effort containing work, decisions and goals.

types.name: Task
types.description: An attributed work item. Assignment does not imply acceptance or completion.

types.name: Goal
types.description: A desired outcome supported by projects or tasks.

types.name: Event
types.description: A particular occurrence, distinct from a recurring preference.

types.name: Decision
types.description: A choice with attribution and supporting reasoning.

types.name: Preference
types.description: A person's preference, qualified by context rather than assumed universal.

types.name: Organization
types.description: An organization mentioned in authorized memory.

types.name: Place
types.description: A place relevant to a memory.

types.name: Topic
types.description: A subject used to connect otherwise related knowledge.

types.name: Obligation
types.description: A distinct reported debt or repayment obligation; never implies acceptance, a transfer or a calculated balance.

types.name: Item
types.description: A particular possession, product, document or service.

types.name: Routine
types.description: A recurring activity; separate from any one occurrence.
